name: ZCC_TB_INTERACTION_STATUS
description: This table stores toolbar interaction region ui state.

columns.name: TB_INTERACTION_STATUS_ID
columns.description: Primary Key

columns.name: AGENT_PARTY_ID
columns.description: PartyId for the loggedin agent.

columns.name: AGENT_NAME
columns.description: AGENT_NAME

columns.name: SLOT_NUMBER
columns.description: UI Slot number for the current Interaction (needed for multi-interaction support)

columns.name: IS_ACTIVE
columns.description: Determines if this slot is currently active (in focus). Y or N default null means N)

columns.name: SESSION_ID
columns.description: Fnd Session Id for Agent.

columns.name: CURRENT_STATE
columns.description: Current Interaction state (Delivered/Established etc).

columns.name: INTERACTION_ID
columns.description: Current Interaction Id.

columns.name: INTERACTION_TYPE
columns.description: Interaction Type for current interaction. Received by toolbar on Delivered Event.  Eg. Inbound Call/Outbound Call etc. Set in toolbar as part of Delivered/Established event from connector.

columns.name: DEVICE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for device. Can be an ID or Name. Set in toolbar as part of Delivered/Established event from connector.

columns.name: MEDIA_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each media item. for eg. CallId in Inbound call scenario. Set in toolbar as part of Delivered/Established event from connector.

columns.name: MEDIA_ITEM_ID_1
columns.description: Unique identifier for 2nd call associated with Interaction (if present)

columns.name: MEDIA_TYPE
columns.description: Media Type for Current Interaction. Set in toolbar as part of Delivered/Established Event from connector.

columns.name: MEDIA_DIRECTION
columns.description: Direction for media item. Set in toolbar as part of Delivered/Established event from connector.

columns.name: RECORD_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Party Id for Interaction record.

columns.name: RECORD_ORG_ID
columns.description: Organization Id for Interaction record.

columns.name: RECORD_RELATIONSHIP_ID
columns.description: Relationship Id for Interaction record.

columns.name: DISPLAY_ATTRIBUTE_VALUE
columns.description: The string representing the interaction record displayed on the toolbar. This is based on ANI for inbound call.

columns.name: INTERACTION_START_TIME_CLIENT
columns.description: Time on client desktop when interaction was started. Can be used to set timer correctly if page is refreshed.

columns.name: CURR_STATE_START_TIME_CLIENT
columns.description: Time n agent desktop when current state was started. Can be used to set timer correctly when page is refreshed.

columns.name: ACCEPT_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if Accept Toolbar button is visible.

columns.name: IGNORE_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if Ignore Toolbar button is visible.

columns.name: ON_HOLD_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if On Hold Toolbar button is visible.

columns.name: OFF_HOLD_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: OFF_HOLD_VISIBLE_FLAG

columns.name: TRANSFER_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if Transfer Toolbar button is visible.

columns.name: CONF_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if Conference Toolbar button is visible.

columns.name: WARM_TRANSFER_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if Warm Transfer Toolbar button is visible.

columns.name: RELEASE_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if Release Toolbar button is visible.

columns.name: END_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if End Interaction Toolbar button is visible.

columns.name: COMPLETE_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if Complete Toolbar button is visible.

columns.name: CANCEL_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if Cancel Toolbar button is visible.

columns.name: TIMER_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if Timer on toolbar is visible for the current interaction state.

columns.name: STYLE_PANEL_VISIBLE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating if the Style Panel (displaying interaction controls and display string) is visible.

columns.name: STYLE_PANEL_INLINE_STYLE
columns.description: Inline style for displaying style panel.

columns.name: OTHER_PARTY_PHONE_NUMBER
columns.description: The phone number of the person with whom the agent talked. (The phone number from which the person called the agent, or the phone number the agent dialed)

columns.name: SWITCH_CALL_ID
columns.description: The handle which uniquely identifies the call in the CTI system.  It will be used by customers and vendor to tie an interaction in fusion back to the record in the telephony system.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
